scores.notes: Daniel in both is a lean older man with short grey hair and a short grey beard, tan skin, in a dark blue fringed robe with a shoulder satchel (left centre-left, right foreground left).
Peter (left raising the lame man, right the dripping man by the fire) has dark curly greying hair, a short dark-grey beard, tanned face and a rough brown cloak in both.
Moses in both has shoulder-length white hair and a full white beard, a brown cloak over a pale robe and a dark crooked staff (left on the rock at the sea, right striking the rock).

Peter (left at far left with hand on chest, right stepping out of the boat) has dark curly hair greying at the sides, a short dark-grey beard, tanned skin and a rough brown cloak over a pale tunic in both.
David in both is a clean-shaven teenage youth with short dark curly hair in a ragged brown tunic with a shoulder pouch (left crouched at the brook, right kneeling to be anointed).

Moses in both is an elderly man with long white hair and a full white beard, tanned skin, a dark brown cloak over a pale robe with a brown sash and a crooked staff (left pointing at the pig, right raising the rod by the rock).

David in both is a lean clean-shaven teenage youth with dark tousled curly hair and tanned skin in a ragged brown tunic with a leather shoulder bag and sling (left at the brook, right standing behind fallen Goliath).
Peter (left leaping from the boat, right walking on the water) has short dark curly hair, a short greying dark beard, tanned skin and a sturdy build in both; the cloak differs only as clothing.

Peter (left standing with the net, right foreground right with hand at his chest) has dark curly hair greying at the temples, a short grizzled beard, tanned lined face and a rough brown cloak over a pale tunic in both.
David in both is a slim clean-shaven youth with dark curly hair and tanned skin in a short brown tunic with a shoulder pouch (left with the sling behind Goliath, right fleeing at far right).

Peter (left lifting the lame man, right leaping from the boat) is a sturdy middle-aged man with short curly salt-and-pepper hair, a short grizzled beard, strong nose and brown cloak in both; the hair reads somewhat greyer on the right but not a clear conflict.
Moses in both is an old man with long white hair and a full white beard, tanned weathered face, brown cloak over a pale robe and a crooked staff (left leading the column, right seated on the stone).
Jesus in both is a man in his thirties with shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard and olive skin, in a white robe with a blue mantle (left before the tomb, right standing in the boat).
Both show a wet sandy seabed path receding between towering curling blue-green waves under a pale cloudy daytime sky, with red mesa cliffs on the far shore; only the viewpoint and the people differ.
Peter (left leaping from the boat, right standing with the net by the fire) has dark curly hair greying at the sides, a short grizzled beard, tanned lined face and a ragged dark brown cloak in both.
Jesus in both has shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard and olive skin, wearing a cream robe with a blue mantle (left standing in the boat, right in profile pointing at the tomb).

Both show a wet sandy-rocky seabed strip opening through dark teal sea under heavy black storm cloud with a pale break at the horizon; left is from the shore as the waves part, right from inside the path with the walls towering.

Both show the same wet sandy seabed path strewn with shells and weed between towering curling teal-green waves under dark storm cloud with a pale gap at the far end; the right adds a rock mound mid-path and a warmer glow but nothing conflicts.

Peter (left foreground with hand on chest, right stepping out of the boat) has short curly greying hair, a short grizzled beard, strong nose, tanned skin and a rough brown cloak over a pale tunic in both; he reads somewhat greyer and older on the left but not a clear conflict.
Daniel is the standing man in a blue robe over cream in both; same short grey hair, short grey-white beard, brown skin, lean older face and build.
David is the fleeing youth with the lyre (left) and the boy being anointed (right); both are a clean-shaven teenager with short dark curly hair, tan skin and slight build.
David is the kneeling anointed boy (left) and the fleeing youth with the lyre (right); both a clean-shaven teenager with short dark curly hair, tan skin and slim build.

Both show the same kind of open wooden fishing boat with a single rope-bound mast on a dark choppy lake with low hilly shoreline and storm cloud; the calmer brightening sky on the right is the change the passages ask for.

Daniel is the man hauled up on the rope (left) and the man standing among lions (right); both have short grey hair, a short grey beard, brown skin, an older lean face and the same blue robe over cream.
David fleeing with the lyre (left) and kneeling at the brook (right) is the same clean-shaven teenage boy with short dark curly hair, tan skin and slim build.

Peter stepping from the boat (left) and leaping overboard in a brown cloak (right) is a sturdy middle-aged man with short curly greying hair and a short grey beard; the hair reads somewhat greyer on the right but age, beard, face and build agree.
David fleeing with the lyre (left) and standing with the sling (right, smaller) is the same clean-shaven teenage boy with short dark curly hair, tan skin and slim build.

Peter is the cloaked man with the net standing by the fire (left) and the man walking on the water (right); both a sturdy middle-aged man with short dark curly hair and a short dark-greying beard, tan skin, similar face; slightly more grey on the left.

Moses with the crook beside the priest (left) and on the rock facing the sea (right, mostly from behind) both show white hair, a white beard, an old man's build and a dark mantle over a cream robe; the right face is largely turned away and the hair is wind-blown longer, but no cue conflicts.

Moses leading the crowd with a crook (left) and standing beside the priest (right) is the same old man with swept-back white hair, full white beard, tanned lined face and dark mantle over a cream robe.

Daniel on the rope in the den (left, small) and the watcher in the blue robe at the left foreground (right) both have short grey hair, a short grey beard, tan skin, an older lean face and the same blue robe over cream with a satchel.

Daniel with open hands beside the angel (left) and on the rope in the den (right, small) both have short grey hair, a short grey beard, brown skin, an older lean face and the same blue robe over cream.

Peter on the left (the dripping-wet cloaked man by the fire; the other cloaked fisherman is similar) has mostly dark curly hair and a dark greying beard and looks about forty-five; the diving Peter on the right has clearly silver-grey hair and a grey-white beard and looks a decade or more older.

Moses seated between his two supporters (left) and standing with the crook by the priest (right) is the same old man with white hair, full white beard, tanned deeply lined face and dark mantle over a cream robe; hair is somewhat longer on the left.

Peter stepping onto the water (left) has dark curly hair and a dark beard with only some grey and looks mid-forties; the diving Peter (right) has clearly silver-grey curls and a grey-white beard and looks a decade or more older.
Left shows an unparted stormy sea at a rocky palm-lined shore under a dark night sky with no dry path at all; right is a daylit sand corridor between two water walls with red mesas beyond.
Left is a daylit sandy corridor between towering water walls with red cliffs at left; right is an unparted stormy sea at a rocky palm shore at night with no dry path visible.

Left Jesus is clear (shoulder-length dark brown hair, short dark beard, standing in the boat); on the right he is a tiny distant figure on the centre cross with head bowed, too small to compare the face beyond dark hair.
Jesus in both has shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard, the same lean face and build, and a white tunic under a grey-blue mantle (standing in the boat left, on the water right).
David in both is a clean-shaven youth with short dark-brown curly hair, the same boyish face and lean build, in a ragged brown tunic with a shoulder satchel.

Both show the same kind of open single-masted wooden fishing boat on a grey-green choppy lake with an olive-brown hilly shore at the right; the right adds a torn sail and distant boats, but the lake and coast are compatible.
Moses in both is an elderly man with shoulder-length white hair, a full white beard and weathered tan skin in a cream tunic and brown mantle (striking the rock left, seated between two men right).

Moses in both is an old man with wind-blown white hair and a long white beard in a cream tunic and brown mantle; left is a three-quarter back view but hair, beard and build match the seated figure on the right.

David in both is a slim clean-shaven boy with short dark curly hair and tan skin in a ragged brown tunic with a shoulder satchel; he looks a touch younger with head bowed on the right, but no cue conflicts.

Both show an open single-masted plank fishing boat with rope rigging on a dark blue choppy lake ringed by low hills under storm cloud; the right adds a torn sail and bigger waves, which the storm-then-calm change explains.

Moses in both is an elderly man with swept-back white hair, a full white beard and tan skin in a cream tunic with dark sash and brown mantle, holding a staff; skin is slightly darker on the left but face and build match.

Peter (stepping onto the water at left; lifting the beggar at right) has short dark curly hair greying at the temples, a short grizzled beard, tan skin and a strong build in a rough brown cloak in both.
Jesus in both has shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard, the same slim build and long face, in a white tunic with a grey-blue mantle (on the water left, calling at the tomb right).
Daniel in both is an older lean man with close-cropped grey hair, a short grey beard and tan skin in a dark blue fringed robe over a cream tunic with a scroll case at the hip.
Peter (leaping from the boat at left; raising the beggar at right) has short dark curly hair with grey, a short grizzled beard, tan skin and a sturdy build in a rough brown cloak in both.

Both show a grey overcast Sea of Galilee with dark hills and a stony pebble shore where a small coal fire burns beside the waiting Jesus; the right adds a village with palms across the bay, compatible with a closer viewpoint.

Peter (raising the beggar at left; wading ashore in a pale tunic at right) is a sturdy middle-aged man with short curly greying hair and a short grizzled beard in both; the hair reads a little greyer on the right but face, beard and build match.
Daniel among the lions (left) and climbing out of the den (right) is the same lean older man with cropped grey hair, short grey beard and tan skin, wearing the same blue fringed robe and satchel.

Left den is an enclosed bottle-shaped vault whose walls curve in to a small opening with a barred grate; right den is a broad open-topped straight cylinder with a wide mouth and wooden lid, so the pit's architecture conflicts despite the same stone blocks.
Jesus calling at the tomb (left) and standing in the boat (right) has the same shoulder-length dark brown hair, short dark beard, slim build and white tunic with blue mantle.
Moses stretching his hand over the sea (left) and walking at the right front of the column (right) is the same old man with windswept white hair, long white beard and brown cloak over a pale tunic.
Peter stepping from the boat (left) and pulling the lame man up (right) both have dark curly hair, a short grey-streaked beard, weathered tan face and sturdy build.

Peter with hand on chest in the courtyard (left) and leaping from the boat (right) both have short curly hair, a short greying beard, tan skin and sturdy build; hair reads greyer on the right but both are greying, so no clear conflict.
Daniel climbing out of the den (left) and addressing the king (right) is the same lean older man with cropped grey hair, short grey beard and tan skin, in the same blue fringed robe with satchel.
David kneeling to be anointed (left, head bowed) and dodging the spear (right) is the same slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair and fair ruddy skin in a brown tunic with shoulder bag.

Both show a wet sandy, rock-strewn seabed corridor between heaped green waves under a dark storm sky with a rock outcrop where Moses stands; the walls are higher on the left, which fits the later moment, and the right adds shoreline cliffs seen from the bank.

Jesus calling at the tomb (left) and on the cross at upper right (right, small, head bowed) both show a slim man with shoulder-length dark hair, a short dark beard and light tan skin; the right face is small but no cue conflicts.

Jesus on the centre cross (left, small) and walking on the water (right) both show a slim man with shoulder-length dark brown hair, short dark beard and light tan skin; the left face is small but nothing conflicts.
Jesus on the water (left) and calling Lazarus out (right) has the same shoulder-length dark brown hair, short dark beard, slim build and white tunic with blue mantle.

Moses stretching his hand over the sea (left) and standing with staff beside the priest (right) is the same old man with white hair, a full white beard and tanned face in a dark cloak over a pale tunic.
David after the sling throw (left) and kneeling at the brook (right) is the same slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair and fair skin in a brown tunic with shoulder bag.

Both show a single-masted open wooden boat with a torn pale sail on a grey-green choppy sea under heavy storm clouds, with a hilly green shoreline on the horizon; the far boats on the left are compatible.

Both show a calm lake edge with a pebbly shore, a small charcoal fire by the water, a fishing boat with a net of fish just offshore and hazy hills with cypress and stone buildings across the water in daylight; the stone hut by the fire on the right could sit outside the left view.

Moses is the seated white-haired, white-bearded elder in a brown cloak on the left and the white-haired, white-bearded staff-bearer in brown cloak leading the crowd on the right; hair, beard, age and build agree.

Moses is the white-haired, full-white-bearded old man with a staff and brown cloak over a pale robe at the front of the crowd on the left and striking the rock on the right; hair, beard, age and build agree.

Both show the same kind of dark open wooden boat with a bare central mast and rigging in a violent grey-green storm sea under black cloud; the right adds distant cliffs that the close, wave-filled left view would hide, which is compatible.

Jesus on the central cross at left is small but shows long dark hair, a dark beard and a lean build, matching the long-dark-haired, short-bearded lean man standing in the boat at right; no cue conflicts.

Both show a circular pit of large grey dressed-stone blocks with a sandy floor and lions, lit by daylight from an opening above; the left is seen from inside and the right from the rim outside, a compatible change of viewpoint.

Daniel is the older man with short grey hair, trimmed grey beard and tan skin in a blue mantle over a white robe with a shoulder satchel, in the right foreground of the throne hall and among the lions; face, hair and beard match.
Peter is the man with short curly dark hair and a short greying-dark beard walking on the water on the left and standing by the fire with hand on chest on the right; hair, beard, age and build agree.

Moses is the old man with long white hair and a full white beard, brown cloak over a pale robe and a tall staff, standing beside the priest on the left and leading the crowd at right front on the right; hair, beard, age and build agree.

Moses is the seated old man with swept-back white hair and a full white beard in a brown cloak on the left and the white-haired, white-bearded man in a brown cloak striking the rock on the right; hair, beard and age match.

Daniel is the lean older man with cropped grey hair, a trimmed grey beard and tan skin in a blue fringed mantle over a pale robe with a satchel, among the lions on the left and at the right edge before the fiery throne; face, hair and beard match.

Moses is the old man with windblown white hair and a long white beard, brown cloak and crook staff, seen in profile on the rock at left and facing forward beside the priest at right; hair, beard, age and build agree.

Both show a daytime sandy shore and seabed corridor between curling teal-green wave walls under grey storm cloud with pale sandy land beyond; the left is from the near shore as the sea opens and the right looks along the opened path, which is compatible.

Jesus on the central cross at left is small but shows long dark hair, a dark beard and a lean build, matching the long-dark-haired, dark-bearded man pointing at the tomb on the right; no cue conflicts.

Moses is the old man with swept-back white hair and a full white beard, brown cloak over a pale robe and a crook staff, striking the rock on the left and standing by the priest on the right; hair, beard, age and build match.

Daniel is the older tan-skinned man with short grey hair and a grey beard in a blue fringed mantle over a pale robe with a scroll pouch, climbing the rope in the pit on the left and addressing the king on the right; the left is small but hair, beard and age agree.

Jesus on the cross at left has long dark hair, a short dark beard and a lean build, matching the long-dark-haired, dark-bearded lean man in a blue mantle standing on the water at right; hair, beard and build agree.

David is the slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair in a rough brown tunic with a shoulder bag, kneeling under the oil on the left and holding the sling at right; hair, age, skin tone and build match.

Peter is the man with short curly dark hair and a greying beard, hand on chest at the far left of the courtyard and bending to lift the beggar on the right; the left figure is smaller but hair, beard, age and build agree.

Moses is the old man with swept-back white hair and a full white beard in a brown cloak over a pale robe, standing with a crook staff beside the priest on the left and seated with arms held up on the right; hair, beard, age and build match.
Peter holding the net by the fire (left) and raising the lame man (right): both have curly dark hair going grey, short greying beard, weathered tan face, sturdy build, middle age.

Both show a sandy seabed path between teal-green curling wave walls under a cloudy daytime sky with red-tan sandstone cliffs and desert shore; right is the shoreline view as the path opens, left is inside the path - compatible.
David with sling (left) and bending at the brook (right): both a beardless youth with short curly dark-brown hair, tanned skin, slim build, same teen age (and same brown tunic and bag).

Jesus on the cross (left, small, head bowed with crown of thorns) and standing in the boat (right): both have dark brown shoulder-length hair, dark full beard, lean build and similar skin tone; left face is small but cues agree.

Moses striking the rock (left) and facing the sea (right): both an elderly man with white-grey hair and full white beard, tanned skin, brown cloak over pale robe; right is seen from behind in profile but hair, beard and age agree.

Peter raising the lame man (left) and standing by the courtyard fire with hand on chest (right): both have curly dark hair greying at the sides, short grey-flecked beard, weathered tan face, sturdy middle-aged build and brown cloak.

Daniel facing the king (left) and being hoisted on the rope (right): both have short cropped grey hair, short grey beard, lean tanned face, slim older build (and the same blue fringed robe with scroll case).

Peter leaping from the boat (left) and standing by the courtyard fire with hand on chest (right): both have short curly dark hair greying at the temples, short grey-flecked beard, weathered tan face, stocky middle-aged build and brown cloak.
David kneeling under the horn of oil (left) and with the sling (right): both a beardless teenage boy with short curly dark-brown hair, light tan skin, slim build, same brown tunic and shoulder bag.

Peter raising the lame man (left) and leaping from the boat clutching his cloak (right): both have short curly hair, short greying beard, tanned weathered face and sturdy build. Right is noticeably greyer (hair mostly grey vs dark with grey flecks on left), but it reads as the same salt-and-pepper middle-aged man rather than a clear dark-vs-grey conflict.

Moses holding the crook beside the priest (left) and striking the rock (right): both an old man with white hair and full white beard, tanned skin, brown cloak over pale robe; hair is a bit longer on the left but colour, beard and age agree.

Peter stepping out of the boat (left) and wading ashore in a pale tunic (right): both have short curly grey-streaked hair, short greying beard, weathered tan face and sturdy middle-aged build; right slightly greyer but the same look.

Peter in the left foreground of the courtyard with hand on chest (left) and wading ashore in a pale tunic (right): both have curly grey-streaked hair, short grey beard, lined tanned face and sturdy middle-aged build.

Daniel addressing the king (left) and standing among the lions with open hands (right): both have short cropped grey hair, short grey beard, tanned lean face, slim older build, same blue fringed robe and satchel.

Both show the same brown planked single-masted fishing boat on grey-green choppy water under dark storm clouds with green hills on the far shore in daylight; right has the sky clearing as the text asks, and the sail is furled, but boat, lake and hills are compatible.

David standing under the horn of oil (left) and stooping at the brook with sling and staff (right): both a beardless slim teenage boy with short dark curly hair, tanned skin, same rough brown tunic and shoulder bag.

Daniel standing beside the fiery throne (left) and hanging on the rope above the den (right): both have short cropped grey hair, short grey beard, tanned lean face, slim older build and the same blue fringed robe with scroll case.

Moses seated on the stone between two helpers (left) and standing on the rock with arms raised, seen from behind in part profile (right): both have long white hair to the shoulders, a full white beard (visible in profile on the right), aged build, brown cloak over pale robe and the same crook; right face is mostly turned away but hair, beard and age agree.

Moses leading the crowd with a staff (left, mid-size) and striking the rock (right): both an old man with white hair, full white beard, brown cloak over pale robe and similar build. Skin reads somewhat darker brown on the right than the lighter tan on the left, but the whole right scene is painted darker and hair, beard and age agree, so no clear conflict.

Jesus standing on the water reaching to Peter (left) and standing in the boat with arm out (right): both have long dark-brown hair past the shoulders, dark beard, lean face in profile, slim build and the same blue mantle over a pale tunic.

Peter in the left foreground of the courtyard with hand on chest (left) and leaping from the boat clutching his cloak (right): both have curly grey-streaked hair, short grey beard, lined tanned face, sturdy middle-aged build and brown cloak.

Daniel is the older man with short grey hair, trimmed grey beard, tan skin and a blue mantle with a shoulder satchel in both (centre left, right foreground right); small on the right but the cues match.

Both show a sandy seabed corridor between towering green wave walls running back to pale desert dunes; right adds red cliffs and a lighter sky, compatible with a different viewpoint along the same path.
Moses is an old man with long white hair, full white beard, cream robe and brown mantle with a staff in both (arm outstretched at the sea left, seated on the stone right).

Peter in the left courtyard foreground has mostly grey curly hair and a grey beard and looks around sixty, while the man lifting the beggar on the right has dark hair with only light greying and looks younger; grey versus dark hair conflicts.
Both show the same wooden fishing boat on a lake ringed by steep dark cliffs and headlands under heavy storm cloud in daylight; calmer water and breaking light on the right is the asked-for calm.

Moses is the old man with white hair, full white beard, cream robe and brown mantle holding a staff in both (striking the rock left, leading the crowd on the right); hair is slightly longer on the left.
Peter (stepping onto the water left, the dripping-wet man by the fire right) has short dark curly hair with some grey, a short greying dark beard, tanned skin and a stocky build in both.
Moses is the old man with swept-back white hair, long white beard, cream robe and dark brown mantle with a staff in both (arm out over the sea left, pointing ahead in the crowd right).

Both show a calm pale-morning lake ringed by tan hills with a stony shore, a coal fire at the waterline, cypresses and olive trees; the right adds palms and hillside houses seen from the boat, a compatible viewpoint.
Jesus has shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard, the same face and build, and a cream robe with blue mantle in both (standing in the bow left, on the water at right).

Both show the same hill-country farmstead: pale flat-roofed stone houses behind a low dry-stone wall, olive trees, cypresses and terraced hills under a clear daytime sky, seen from the road and then from the yard.
David is a slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair, light-tan skin and a brown tunic with shoulder bag in both (stooping at the brook left, kneeling to be anointed right).
Daniel is the older lean man with cropped grey hair, short grey beard, tan skin and a blue fringed mantle over a cream robe in both (in the den left, before the king right).
Both show the same wooden boat with a tall curved stern post in a daytime gale, dark rain cloud overhead, white-capped grey-blue waves and the same line of dark cliffs on the right horizon.
Jesus is clear on the left (long dark hair, dark beard, blue mantle), but on the right he is a tiny distant figure on the centre cross with head bowed, too small to judge face or beard.

David is a slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair, tanned skin and a ragged brown tunic with shoulder bag in both (picking stones at the brook left, ducking the spear with his harp right).

Jesus has shoulder-length dark brown hair, a dark beard, lean build and the same skin tone in both; on the right he is small on the centre cross with head bowed, but hair, beard and build are still readable in daylight and agree.
Moses is the old man with long white hair, full white beard, cream robe and dark brown mantle with a staff in both (pointing at the pig left, seated with arms held up right).

Both show the same open wooden boat with a single mast and a stern cushion on wide open water under heavy dark storm cloud; the right is the storm at its height with no shore visible, the left the asked-for calm with distant headlands.

Both show pale limestone flat-roofed houses with dry-stone walls on dry terraced hills with olive trees and cypresses under the same cloudy daylight; left is the yard up close, right the compound seen from the road.
Daniel being lifted from the den on the left and standing right of the steps on the right both have short grey hair, a short grey beard, a lean older face and the same blue mantle with satchel.

Peter with hand on chest on the left and the dripping-wet man at the fire on the right both have short dark curly hair with some grey, a short dark beard, tanned skin and a sturdy build in a brown cloak over a pale tunic.

Peter gripping the lame man's hand on the left and stepping onto the water on the right both have short dark curly hair with grey flecks, a short dark beard, tanned skin and a sturdy middle-aged build.
Both show dry terraced hills with olive trees and dry-stone walls and pale flat-roofed stone houses in daylight; the left sees the compound from the road, the right stands in its yard.

Daniel in the left foreground and beside the angel on the right both have close-cropped grey hair, a short grey beard, an older olive-brown face and the same blue mantle over a pale robe with a satchel.
Peter wading ashore on the left and leaping from the boat on the right both have curly grey-streaked dark hair, a short greying beard, tanned skin and a sturdy middle-aged build.

David dodging the spear on the left and stooping at the brook on the right is the same clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair, tanned skin and a slim build in a brown tunic with a shoulder bag.

Moses seated with arms held up on the left and walking with a staff at the right edge on the right is an old man with white hair, a full white beard and a brown mantle over a pale robe; he is smaller on the right but the cues match.

Both show a round sunken pit of large grey stone blocks with lions on a sandy floor and people at the rim above in daylight; the left is seen from outside with city walls, the right from the floor under an arched overhang, which is a viewpoint change.
Moses seated in the middle on the left and raising the rod on the right is an old man with white hair, a full white beard, weathered tanned skin and a brown mantle over a pale robe.

Moses pointing at the pig on the left and leading the crowd with a staff on the right is an old man with white hair, a full white beard, tanned skin and a brown mantle over a pale robe; he is smaller on the right but the cues match.
Jesus calling at the tomb on the left and standing on the water on the right has the same shoulder-length dark brown hair, full dark beard, olive skin and a blue mantle over a pale robe.

Moses faces the viewer on the left (white hair, white beard, brown mantle) but on the right he is seen from behind on the rock with his face turned away; only white hair and a beard edge show, so identity cannot be confirmed.
